arguments.command:
bash -lc 'python3 - << "PY" 
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W, H = 1200, 800
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), color=(40,40,40))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", 40)
except:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
# Header
draw.text((40,40), "Settings", font=font, fill=(255,255,255))
# Section LOOK
section_y = 120
draw.text((60, section_y), "LOOK", font=ImageFont.truetype("DejaVuSans.ttf", 28) if True else font, fill=(200,200,200))
# Screen line
screen_label = "screen: cassette"
draw.text((80, section_y+40), screen_label, font=font, fill=(230,230,230))
# Cassette variant label
cassette_variant = "color scheme: Tape · Mono"
draw.text((100, section_y+100), cassette_variant, font=font, fill=(220,220,220))
# Additional lines
draw.text((60, H-140), "Cassette selected snapshot (using fixtures):", font=font, fill=(180,180,180))
draw.rectangle([50, 160, W-50, 180], outline=(100,100,100))
img.save("screenshot.png")
print("saved screenshot.png")
PY'
